applied_settings: REPAIRED CURVE, REBUILT BY HAND 2026-08-23 - NOT bit-identical to the 2026-08-20 curve that paper sections 5.7.4 and 5.7.5 rest on. That profile was never saved; the operator redrew it from the design and deliberately altered it slightly. Same design and same qualitative shape - stock voltage slope restored below ~925 mV, flattened region above it left intact, memory +2500 - but different frequencies. PROBED BEFORE STARTING, not assumed: at a locked 3090 target gemm reads 2906.1 MHz mean / 2910 max against the 2026-08-20 gemm runs' 2887.1 and 2898.5, and membw reads 2947.0 against that run's 2909.9; memory 16301 under load confirms the +2500 offset. THIS IS A SECOND INSTANCE OF THE REPAIR DESIGN, NOT A RE-MEASUREMENT OF THE FIRST. It tests whether 5.7.4's findings belong to the mechanism or to one particular hand-drawn curve. Clean protocol: NVIDIA Instant Replay OFF, encoder and decoder 0% over 4 samples immediately before start; all 2026-08-20/21 curve-fixed data predates the contamination finding of 5.4.4 and has no clean counterpart, which is why this was run.
